request: Our school library wants a simple catalogue of its books. The librarian should be able to add a book with its title, its author and how many copies the library owns. Students should be able to see all the books, and look at one book to see how many copies are still on the shelf. A student borrows a book by giving their name, and returns it when they are done; a student can only return a book they actually borrowed. When every copy of a book is out, nobody else can borrow it until a copy comes back.
summary:
I've made the change: the catalogue no longer has a way to add books. All of my automatic checks pass.

**What you can do now:**
- Students can see all the books, or look at one book to see how many copies are still on the shelf.
- A student borrows a book by giving their name, and returns it the same way.

**Loading your books:** you'll load the book list into the library's storage yourselves. Each book needs a title, an author and the number of copies you own. I didn't build anything to read your spreadsheet file, and I haven't tested loading one. I filled in sample books directly to run my checks.

**Choices I made for you:**
- Each book gets a number, which students use to pick it.
- A student can borrow more than one copy of the same book.
- Names must be typed exactly the same way when returning a book.

**What is refused:**
- Adding books through the catalogue
- Borrowing a book when every copy is out
- Returning a book the student didn't borrow, or already returned
- A blank student name
- Asking for a book that doesn't exist
messages: I changed my mind: we don't want a way to add books. We will load the books from a CSV file ourselves.
